title: Drone-only TFR set up over Picatinny Arsenal before Thanksgiving
summary: Jake Barber tells of Drone-only TFR set up over Picatinny Arsenal before Thanksgiving, about November 2024 at Picatinny Arsenal, New Jersey, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: about the situation is that there was a TFR set up over Pikatini Arsenal a month prior like before Thanksgiving

plain: Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he once carried a UFO with his aircraft, says that in November 2024, about a month before Thanksgiving, a temporary flight restriction, a no-fly zone in the sky, was set up over Picatinny Arsenal, a US Army base in New Jersey. He says it applied only to drones, and he raises it as a telling detail about what was happening in the skies there.
